notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/duckietown__gym-duckietown --backend fake (exit 0; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wP-061) and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); nothing ran on hardware and no hardware backend was passed. The card lists two entry symbols; this package serves MultiMapEnv (src/gym_duckietown/envs/multimap_env.py:7), the two-map simulator. DuckiebotEnv (src/gym_duckietown/envs/duckiebot_env.py:46) is the ZMQ client of a real Duckiebot and is not served. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python two-map stand-in; the sim backend (gym.make("MultiMap-v0")) was not run because the upstream package and its OpenGL stack were not installed and clone code is never imported. The fake returns one 3-value RGB pixel sample instead of the deployed 480 x 640 x 3 camera frame; the real size is stated in the fidelity gaps and here. Fidelity is F0 (kinematic differential-drive integration with geometric collision checks; no force, contact, actuator, sensor or noise dynamics), determinism seeded with Python random.Random in the fake and numpy RandomState upstream, timestep 33.3 ms from the default 30 fps. The expected Gymnasium-family warnings remain: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 and four G8.NO_UNIT for ticks, action.values, and the seed input and output; there are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The action bound (-1 to 1 per wheel) is derived by the bridge from the clone's action space; the driver declares no Limits and no operator-required bound. Only catalogued cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
